concept.centerRule: The exact phrase establishes the central inventory. Similar tree, river, fruit, leaf, healing, vine, garden, Paradise, and cross language remains bounded until the source supplies a visible relationship.

concept.throughline: The image moves from created trees and Eden’s planted tree through guarded access, four Proverbs metaphors, trees beside water, future Paradise, and the final city’s river, fruit, healing, invitation, and warning.
